name: string_escapes
description: Emit standard JSON escape sequences for named control characters; matched control emits ordinary named literal characters in the identical quotation format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
chars={'line feed':'\n','horizontal tab':'\t','carriage return':'\r','backspace':'\b','form feed':'\f','double quote':'"','backslash':'\\'}
ordinary={'lowercase a':'a','uppercase B':'B','space':' ','period':'.','comma':',','exclamation mark':'!','hyphen':'-'}
for i in range(98):
 n=list(chars)[i%7]; m=list(ordinary)[i%7]
 form=random.choice(['Encode the character {name} as a JSON string.\nJSON: "','Write a JSON string containing only the character {name}.\nJSON: "','Use JSON escaping to represent the character {name}.\nJSON: "'])
 items.append({'prompt':form.format(name=n),'answer':json.dumps(chars[n])[1:]})
 control.append({'prompt':form.format(name=m),'answer':json.dumps(ordinary[m])[1:]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
